item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) estão empatados tecnicamente na véspera do segundo turno da eleição presidencial, mostrou pesquisa Quaest neste sábado. Flávio tem 51% dos votos válidos contra 49% de Lula. A margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos. Nos votos válidos não são computados os brancos, nulos e os indecisos. No primeiro turno, disputado há três semanas, Flávio terminou na liderança com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% de Lula. Considerando as intenções de voto totais, o senador soma 46% contra 45% do presidente, segundo a pesquisa deste sábado. No levantamento anterior, no meio da semana, o placar era de 45% a 44%. Os que disseram que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum dos dois passaram a 8%, ante 9%, enquanto os indecisos foram a 1%, ante 2%. A Quaest ouviu 3.702 eleitores entre sexta-feira e este sábado.

item.title: A FONDO La campaña del Gobierno de Trump para devolver al poder al clan Bolsonaro en Brasil
item.description: Dos funcionarios del Departamento de Estado de lideraron una campaña para devolver al poder al clan Bolsonaro en Brasil e impulsaron con éxito sanciones destinadas a inclinar los comicios a su favor, dijeron 10 funcionarios y exfuncionarios estadounidenses con conocimiento directo del asunto.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Stargardter
item.content:encoded: Dos funcionarios del Departamento de Estado de lideraron una campaña para devolver al poder al clan Bolsonaro en Brasil e impulsaron con éxito sanciones destinadas a inclinar los comicios a su favor, dijeron 10 funcionarios y exfuncionarios estadounidenses con conocimiento directo del asunto. Su plan se pondrá a prueba el domingo, cuando el senador Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrente al presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en una reñida segunda vuelta. Lula ha advertido a Washington que no vulnere la soberanía de Brasil y ha acusado a su oponente de conspirar con el Gobierno de Trump. Los dos funcionarios eran Darren Beattie, asesor principal para Asuntos del Hemisferio Occidental encargado de supervisar la política respecto a Brasil, y Ricardo Pita, otro asesor ascendido este año a subsecretario adjunto para América del Norte. Los detalles de su campaña para devolver a los Bolsonaro al poder no se habían dado a conocer hasta ahora. Beattie y Pita actuaban con mucha libertad de maniobra para gestionar la relación de Washington con el segundo país más poblado de América, según las fuentes. En los meses previos al inicio de la campaña, indicaron a los diplomáticos estadounidenses en Brasil que la política de Washington consistía en restituir a Jair Bolsonaro como líder del país, pese a que había sido inhabilitado para el cargo por planear un golpe de Estado en 2022, cuando perdió las elecciones presidenciales frente a Lula, afirmaron tres de las fuentes. Después de que Bolsonaro fuera condenado a 27 años de prisión en septiembre de 2025, ambos cambiaron de estrategia para apoyar la candidatura de su hijo Flávio, según las tres fuentes. Beattie y Pita ordenaron al personal de la embajada que no interactuara con otros candidatos conservadores que pudieran suponer un desafío para el senador, afirmaron. Desde el año pasado, ambos han abogado con éxito por medidas punitivas de Washington contra Brasil, diseñadas para debilitar a Lula e impulsar a los Bolsonaro, explicaron las 10 fuentes a Reuters. Entre esas medidas figuraban la designación de bandas brasileñas como grupos terroristas y la imposición de sanciones contra el magistrado del Supremo Tribunal Federal que encabezó la investigación sobre Jair Bolsonaro. Reuters no pudo determinar hasta qué punto ambos actuaban siguiendo órdenes de la Casa Blanca o del secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio. Trump, un defensor acérrimo de Bolsonaro desde su derrota electoral en 2022, no ha respaldado públicamente a ningún candidato. La Casa Blanca se negó a hacer comentarios y remitió las preguntas al Departamento de Estado. El portavoz del Departamento de Estado, Tommy Pigott, no respondió sobre directrices específicas relacionadas con Beattie y Pita, pero afirmó en un comunicado: "Todas las acciones emprendidas por Estados Unidos contra los narcotraficantes y para proteger la libertad de expresión tienen como objetivo defender los derechos y las vidas del pueblo estadounidense". "El pueblo brasileño tiene derecho a elegir a sus líderes mediante elecciones libres y justas", agregó. La oficina de Lula no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios. Orna Blum, una de las funcionarias que habló con Reuters sobre la labor de Beattie y Pita, dirigió la oficina del Departamento de Estado para Brasil y el Cono Sur hasta que se jubiló el año pasado debido a su oposición al Gobierno de Trump. Washington "tiene todo el derecho a perseguir sus intereses económicos y estratégicos", afirmó. "Pero cuando los instrumentos de la política exterior se utilizan para presionar a otra democracia sobre el destino judicial de un aliado político, se ha traspasado la línea entre la diplomacia y la intervención política". SANCIONES Beattie es un antiguo redactor de discursos de la Casa Blanca despedido en 2018 tras intervenir en un acto al que asistían nacionalistas blancos. También es el artífice de la "diplomacia de la libertad de expresión", una política defendida por los aliados de Trump que busca castigar a las naciones a las que acusan de censurar el discurso de derecha de estadounidenses, empresas y aliados de derecha a nivel mundial. Estados Unidos ha acusado al juez del STF Alexandre de Moraes de violar los derechos de libertad de expresión al encarcelar a brasileños por publicaciones políticas en redes sociales y al censurar contenidos de empresas estadounidenses de redes sociales. Moraes, que ha argumentado que estaba eliminando de las redes sociales las noticias falsas que socavaban la confianza pública en las instituciones democráticas del país, no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. Pita es uno de los muchos en el círculo de Rubio que ven a Lula como una amenaza para los intereses de Washington en América Latina. Rubio ha sido una figura clave en la agresiva política del Gobierno de Trump en la región, que ha incluido una invasión de Venezuela para derrocar a Nicolás Maduro, un bloqueo petrolero a Cuba y ataques militares contra embarcaciones sospechosas de transportar drogas procedentes de América Latina. Beattie y Pita se sintieron atraídos por la política de derecha de la familia Bolsonaro, su antipatía hacia Lula y la idea de que Jair Bolsonaro fue víctima de abusos por parte del STF de Brasil. Al igual que Trump en 2020, Bolsonaro se negó a reconocer su derrota en las elecciones presidenciales brasileñas de 2022, lo que desencadenó disturbios por parte de sus seguidores, que irrumpieron en edificios gubernamentales. El STF lo condenó en septiembre de 2025 por conspirar para dar un golpe de Estado con el fin de mantenerse en el poder. Antes de la condena, a principios de 2025, los Bolsonaro presionaban agresivamente a Washington para que impusiera sanciones, en virtud de la Ley Magnitsky Global de Responsabilidad en materia de Derechos Humanos, contra Moraes, quien había dirigido las investigaciones penales sobre Jair Bolsonaro. La ley es una norma federal de 2016 que permite a EEUU imponer sanciones a personas extranjeras responsables de abusos contra los derechos humanos o de corrupción grave. Alrededor de abril de 2025, el hijo menor de Jair Bolsonaro, Eduardo, visitó a Beattie en su despacho del Departamento de Estado, según dos antiguos funcionarios estadounidenses. Eduardo Bolsonaro llevaba defendiendo públicamente las sanciones Magnitsky contra Moraes al menos desde 2024, y en marzo de 2025 afirmó que era "prácticamente seguro" que Washington las impondría. Eduardo Bolsonaro no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios. Beattie llamó a la Oficina de Control de Activos Extranjeros (OFAC) del Tesoro para solicitar que se impusieran sanciones Magnitsky contra Moraes, afirmó un exfuncionario estadounidense, quien destacó que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, cuyo departamento gestiona las sanciones Magnitsky a través de la OFAC, no puso ninguna objeción. Estados Unidos anunció sanciones Magnitsky contra Moraes en julio de 2025, alegando sus presuntas violaciones del derecho a la libertad de expresión al censurar publicaciones antigubernamentales en las redes sociales. Un funcionario del Tesoro afirmó que Bessent y Rubio están "totalmente alineados con la política exterior del Gobierno". DESIGNACIONES La familia Bolsonaro también presionaba para que Washington designara a las principales bandas de Brasil —el Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) y el Comando Vermelho (CV)— como organizaciones terroristas. Creían que dicha medida perjudicaría a Lula, a quien algunos han criticado por no controlar la delincuencia. Eduardo Bolsonaro había entablado amistad con Pita a través de los círculos conservadores estadounidenses, y ambos apoyaban la iniciativa de designar a las bandas como grupos terroristas. En mayo de 2025, Pita se unió a una delegación de Washington que visitó a Jair Bolsonaro en su residencia de Brasilia mientras esperaba su juicio, según comunicados públicos. También formaba parte del grupo David Gamble, el máximo responsable de sanciones del Departamento de Estado en ese momento. De vuelta en Washington, Pita pidió a los responsables de sanciones del Departamento de Estado que estudiaran cómo podrían aplicarse en Brasil las designaciones como organizaciones terroristas, similares a las anunciadas contra los cárteles mexicanos en febrero de 2025, afirmó un exfuncionario. En mayo de 2026 —tras el ascenso de Pita a un puesto que le apartó de los asuntos relacionados con Brasil—, Flávio Bolsonaro se reunió en Washington con Beattie y el subsecretario de Estado Christopher Landau para debatir "la urgencia de designar al PCC y al Comando Vermelho como organizaciones terroristas extranjeras", según una publicación en X del influencer de derecha Paulo Figueiredo que incluía fotos de los asistentes. El Departamento de Estado anunció la designación al día siguiente. Reuters no pudo determinar el alcance de la influencia de Pita o Beattie a la hora de conseguir la decisión final. En julio de 2025, Washington también anunció una serie de medidas adicionales contra Brasil, entre ellas la revocación de los visados de ocho magistrados del STF y la imposición de aranceles del 50% a los productos brasileños, alegando la "persecución" contra Jair Bolsonaro. Reuters no pudo determinar qué papel, si es que hubo alguno, desempeñaron Beattie o Pita en las medidas adicionales. Pero si su intención era socavar a Lula, muchas de ellas resultaron contraproducentes, según analistas políticos de Brasil. Las medidas dirigidas contra el STF no impidieron en absoluto que este siguiera adelante con el juicio a Bolsonaro, mientras que los aranceles impulsaron los índices de popularidad del Gobierno de Lula, señalaron analistas. Las principales empresas estadounidenses y brasileñas que dependen del comercio bilateral —entre ellas el gigante cárnico JBS (JBSS.O) , controlado por los multimillonarios brasileños Wesley y Joesley Batista— también se opusieron a los aranceles, que Washington acabó suavizando. La campaña de Beattie y Pita también sufrió reveses. Sin una explicación oficial por parte del Departamento del Tesoro, Washington retiró al juez Moraes de la lista de sanciones Magnitsky en diciembre, y en marzo Brasil prohibió a Beattie entrar en el país para visitar a Bolsonaro en prisión.

item.title: North Korea's Kim Jong Un returns from China after war memorial visit, state media says
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un returned to his country by road on Sunday after visiting a historic Korean War memorial in the Chinese border city of Dandong, North Korean state media reported.
item.dc:creator: Cynthia Kim, Joyce Lee
item.content:encoded: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un returned to his country by road on Sunday after visiting a historic Korean War memorial in the Chinese border city of Dandong, North Korean state media reported. Kim visited the city on Saturday and crossed a newly opened bridge that connects the country to its biggest trading partner, China, which was seen as symbolizing a push by Beijing and Pyongyang to expand trade ties. North Korean state media heavily emphasized the historical weight of the visit, describing the bilateral relationship as an "unbreakable" bond forged during the 1950-1953 conflict. Kim stated during his tour that the North Korean people would "forever remember the glorious years of fighting alongside the Chinese people" and pass down "generational gratitude to the Chinese people who helped our revolution with blood," according to the KCNA. The visit is seen as a renewed [USN:L1N46A01U TEXT:"push"] by China and North Korea to bolster their economic relationship ahead of a trip to the region by US President Donald Trump next month. It also highlights a sophisticated diplomatic balancing act by Pyongyang, which has been deepening [USN:L4N44L021 TEXT:"military ties"] with Moscow in the past two years. Guided by Wang Huning, the fourth-ranking official in the Chinese Communist Party, Kim visited the "Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea" in the border city of Dandong, accompanied by a high-level North Korean delegation that included his sister, Kim Yo Jong, and Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui. Kim last visited Beijing in September 2025 for a military parade, and Chinese President Xi Jinping visited North Korea in June. "Enjoying a bird's-eye view at the middle point of the newly-inaugurated bridge, Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed expectation that the bridge would undoubtedly and correctly fulfill its historic mission of linking the two countries and firmly joining the minds of the peoples of the two countries," KCNA reported. The two Koreas are technically at war after their 1950-53 war ended in an armistice rather than a peace treaty.

item.title: SGA, Thunder hope a new streak starts vs. Clippers
item.description: Oklahoma City Thunder superstar Shai Gilgeous-Alexander will look to start another streak Sunday when the Thunder host the Los Angeles Clippers.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Oklahoma City Thunder superstar Shai Gilgeous-Alexander will look to start another streak Sunday when the Thunder host the Los Angeles Clippers. Gilgeous-Alexander's NBA-record streak of 141 consecutive games with 20 or more points was snapped in Thursday's 96-84 win over Denver. Gilgeous-Alexander finished with 17 points versus the Nuggets, scoring 10 in the fourth quarter to make a run at extending the streak before pulling himself out of the game with 1:24 remaining and a Thunder win out of reach. "I feel like you always treat the game with respect," Gilgeous-Alexander said. "God willing, I have many more games to start on a streak. So, it's not the end of the world." Gilgeous-Alexander doesn't figure to have another streak quite that long. All-time great Wilt Chamberlain previously held the record with 126 consecutive games with 20 or more points. No other player has had a streak of 100 such games. "If you don't play basketball, you probably don't even realize how crazy (the streak) is," Oklahoma City's Jalen Williams said. "Like, people in video games don't do that. ... It's very impressive. I can confidently say that one will be untouched for a while." After a season in which he was limited to just 33 regular-season games due to injury and missed much of the postseason, Williams has had a strong start to this season. He had 21 points on 7-of-15 shooting in Thursday's win. It's early, but the Thunder's defense figures to be one of the NBA's best yet again this season. Through two games, Oklahoma City is holding opponents to just 95.9 points per 100 possessions. The Thunder led the NBA in defensive rating a year ago at 106.5 and points off turnovers with 22.0. The Clippers will need to show plenty of improvement in ball security against the Thunder after committing 26 turnovers in Friday's 125-117 loss to the Lakers. In that loss, Darius Garland had a career-high nine turnovers. Clippers coach Tyronn Lue said Garland needed to be better. "He's the head of the snake, and he has to take care of the basketball, score the basketball, and also get guys involved," Lue said. "Teams are going to throw a lot of different looks at him, so he's got to be ready for it." Sunday's game is the second in a stretch where the Clippers will play four of five games away from home. Los Angeles is averaging 22 turnovers through two games. "We're going to play hard," Lue said. "We're going to scrap to the end. ... We've got to do a better job of taking care of the ball." The Thunder have swept the season series between the teams in each of the last two seasons. The Clippers have lost nine consecutive games in Oklahoma City. Their last road win over the Thunder came in March 2020. An Oklahoma City win could help the Thunder beyond just this year's standings. The Thunder are likely to own the Clippers' first-round pick in the 2027 NBA Draft. Los Angeles remains without Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal, Max Strus and Yanic Konan Niederhauser. --Field Level Media

item.title: Top 25 roundup: Cincinnati shocks No. 8 Texas Tech; No. 1 Miami rolls
item.description: Cincinnati quarterback JC French IV threw for four touchdowns and Cole Tabb ran for a career-high 173 yards and a score as the host Bearcats posted their biggest upset in nearly 20 years with a 37-24 Big 12 victory over No. 8 Texas Tech.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cincinnati quarterback JC French IV threw for four touchdowns and Cole Tabb ran for a career-high 173 yards and a score as the host Bearcats posted their biggest upset in nearly 20 years with a 37-24 Big 12 victory over No. 8 Texas Tech. After squandering an opportunity to win last weekend at West Virginia, the Bearcats completed a 180-degree turn by dominating the Red Raiders to snap a two-game losing streak. It marked the Bearcats' largest win over a ranked foe since they beat No. 7 Rutgers 30-11 on Nov. 18, 2006. It also served as the fourth win over a Top 10 foe in school history. French, who completed 19 of 30 passes for 172 yards, threw for three touchdowns in the final 7:48 of the first half to turn a 6-3 deficit into a 24-6 halftime lead. He connected with Tabb for a 4-yard score, Malachi Henry for a 5-yard touchdown and Lyviel Waters for 2 yards with five seconds left in the half. Texas Tech tried to rally early in the third. Peyton Morgan picked off French and returned it 53 yards for a touchdown with 8:49 remaining in the quarter to cut the deficit to 24-15. Cincinnati responded with a nine-play, 80-yard drive that French capped with a 17-yard pass to Larenzo Fenner. No. 1 Miami 52, Pittsburgh 23 Malachi Toney caught a school-record 16 passes for 194 yards and three touchdowns to lead the Hurricanes to a comfortable Atlantic Coast Conference win at home against the Panthers. Toney finished the first half with 11 catches for 147 yards to secure his sixth career double-digit catch game. The Hurricanes (7-0, 5-0 ACC) won their first game as the nation's top-ranked team since 2002. Miami quarterback Darian Mensah was efficient once again, completing 31 of 37 passes for 387 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions. Pitt (5-3, 2-3) dropped its third consecutive game since losing quarterback Mason Heintschel for the season with a torn ACL. Holden Geriner made his second start in Pitt's past three games. He completed 18 of 32 passes for 268 yards and one touchdown. No. 6 Indiana 13, Michigan 6 (OT) Josh Hoover scored on a 4-yard keeper in overtime to lift the Hoosiers to a Big Ten victory over Michigan in Ann Arbor, Mich. Turbo Richard rushed 19 times for 68 yards and Lee Beebe Jr. added 56 yards on 12 carries for Indiana (7-1, 4-1), which had not won at Michigan since 1967. Hoover completed 8 of 18 passes for 81 yards and his first interception of the year while Nico Radicic booted two field goals. Freshman quarterback Tommy Carr hit 20 of 32 passes for 167 yards in his first start for Michigan. JJ Buchanan caught six passes for 57 yards and Trey Butkowski kicked two field goals, including a 26-yarder on the final play of regulation. No. 18 LSU, Auburn 17 Sam Leavitt threw for three touchdowns and ran for a fourth as LSU routed host Auburn for an SEC win. Leavitt completed 32 of 45 for a career-high 387 yards as LSU outgained Auburn 552-271. Jackson Harris caught nine passes for 178 yards and two scores for LSU (6-2, 3-2 SEC), which ended an eight-game losing streak in SEC road games dating to the 2024 season. Byrum Brown passed for 160 yards and rushed for a team-high 21 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries for Auburn (4-3, 2-3), which never led one week after upsetting top-ranked Georgia. No. 23 SMU 59, Cal 20 Kendrick Raphael rushed for 104 yards and two touchdowns against his former team to help the Mustangs pull away from the Golden Bears for an ACC win in Dallas. Raphael, who rushed for 943 yards and 13 touchdowns for Cal last season, also snared a touchdown pass from Kevin Jennings, who completed 16 of 23 attempts for 223 yards and three touchdowns. Christian Rhodes added two short touchdown runs for the Mustangs (6-1, 3-1 ACC), who outscored Cal 42-0 in the second half after trailing by three at halftime. Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele completed 27 of 37 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown for the Golden Bears (3-5, 2-3), who scored first when they moved the ball 65 yards in seven plays on their opening drive. Sagapolutele capped the march with a 10-yard touchdown pass to Chase Hendricks. No. 24 Northwestern 42, Rutgers 14 Aidan Chiles threw three touchdowns and ran for two scores as the Wildcats raced out to a big lead in the first half and rolled to the Big Ten victory in Evanston, Ill. Northwestern (6-1, 3-1) earned its fourth straight win as Chiles completed 19 of 25 passes for 219 yards and added 83 rushing yards. Caleb Komolafe rushed for 150 yards, which included a 33-yard score that put the Wildcats up 28-3 late in the first half. Griffin Wilde added nine catches for 133 yards and a score. Antwan Raymond rushed for a season-high 150 yards and Clay Thevenin added 116 yards for Rutgers (2-5, 1-3), which lost its 46th consecutive game against a ranked opponent. Starting quarterback Dylan Lonergan played just three snaps before getting hurt on a scramble. Backup AJ Surace completed 7 of 18 passes for 64 yards. --Field Level Media

item.title: Arrests in Barcelona after 'anti-system' rioters loot shops, set fires
item.description: A total of 100 people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday evening after hooded demonstrators who participated in an anti-establishment rally looted shops and set fire to street furniture around the city's central Plaza de Catalunya.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A total of 100 people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday evening after hooded demonstrators who participated in an anti-establishment rally looted shops and set fire to street furniture around the city's central Plaza de Catalunya. Núria Parlon, the interior minister for the Spanish region of Catalonia, said around 25% of those arrested were minors. More than 30 fires were set and 14 stores vandalised or looted in a part of town popular with tourists and weekend shoppers, she added. Demonstrators were called in social media posts to a movement "against the system." The posts also used the slogan "Institut Indignats", a translation of the movement "Lyceés Indignés" which was used to rally students who have protested in France in recent weeks. In English, the phrases translate as "Indignant High School Student." Social media videos show people trapped inside shops including department store El Corte Ingles after shutters were lowered to prevent looting. Other posts showed hooded demonstrators dressed in black kicking in shop windows and making off with goods, in some cases encouraged by online viewers. Barcelona Mayor Jaume Collboni said acts of vandalism in the city "will not go unpunished", including legal consequences for the guardians of any minors involved.

item.title: Antonelli on pole for US Grand Prix that could secure F1 title
item.description: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli will start on pole position for a US Grand Prix that could make him Formula One's youngest world champion, and Italy's first since 1953, if results go his way on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli will start on pole position for a US Grand Prix that could make him Formula One's youngest world champion, and Italy's first since 1953, if results go his way on Sunday. Red Bull's Max Verstappen joined the 20-year-old on the front row after Saturday's qualifying at Austin's Circuit of the Americas with teammate Isack Hadjar qualifying third and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc completing the second row. Antonelli has a 102-point lead in the championship over closest rival and teammate George Russell, who qualified only sixth, with 125 points still to be won after Sunday's 56 lap race. To take the title in Texas, the Italian will need to win with Russell and Ferrari's seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton finishing no higher than ninth or fifth respectively. Otherwise, his next opportunity will be in Mexico next weekend. Hamilton qualified fifth after setting the fastest time in final practice but was then unable to continue the momentum into qualifying. GOOD TO BE BACK The unexpected pole was Antonelli's first since Belgium in July, and seventh so far this season, and he found the speed just when he needed it. "It feels good to be back," he said over the team radio after a gusty session. "We got pole, so we will try to win tomorrow," he added in comments to the crowd after stepping out of the car. "Max has been very quick and Isack did an incredible job, so it won't be easy. We will try to get a good start and hopefully we lead into Turn One, then set the pace, even though it will be very tight." Antonelli set his time of one minute 34.035 with his first flying lap of the final phase, leaving him 0.179 quicker than Verstappen who won last year in Austin from pole and has also won the last two races this season in Malaysia and Singapore. "There were no mistakes but just no grip and (the car) started to slide a lot and then the final lap, you can see that it's not really happening with the tail wind in places," said Verstappen. "So you try to push a bit more, you hit the bump wrong and the car is like a kangaroo and you have a massive slide, so you know the lap is over." Hadjar also said he had a tailwind, costing him time and a possible shot at pole. Russell hoped strategy could get him back in contention on Sunday but recognised Antonelli had landed another telling blow. "Qualifying was looking OK to be honest until we got to Q3," said the Briton. "I just did two bad laps and that's why we were where we were. Kimi did a great job." Leclerc recalled that he won in 2024 from fourth on the grid and hoped he might repeat the feat, blaming tyre temperatures for his Saturday problems. "There was a bit more cloud in Q3. We lost one or two degrees of track temp and, for us, it was night and day different and already from the out lap I felt I was having lots of difficulties," said the Monegasque. McLaren's Oscar Piastri qualified seventh, one place ahead of reigning world champion teammate Lando Norris, and Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad was ninth fastest but has a five-place grid penalty for a power unit component change. That will lift teammate Liam Lawson to ninth with Alpine's Pierre Gasly also moving up to complete the top 10. Lawson did not take part in the final phase, preferring to save tyres for Sunday and knowing he was unlikely to get much higher up the grid.

item.title: Devils limit Kings to 13 shots, register third consecutive win
item.description: Arseny Gritsyuk scored for the fifth straight game to help the New Jersey Devils seal a 3-1 win against Los Angeles Kings on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Arseny Gritsyuk scored for the fifth straight game to help the New Jersey Devils seal a 3-1 win against Los Angeles Kings on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J. Anthony Mantha and Brett Pesce also scored, and Jake Allen made 12 saves for New Jersey, which has won five of the past six. Scott Laughton scored and Anton Forsberg made 23 saves for the Kings, who had won two in a row following a 0-4-2 start to the season. Pesce gave the Devils a 2-1 lead at 8:08 of the third period. The veteran defenseman had the time and space to hold the puck and wait for Kings forward Andre Lee to slide by before scoring with a wrist shot from above the right hash marks. The Kings briefly thought they tied it with 4:36 left on a deflection by Trevor Moore, but it was quickly ruled on the ice that he had used a high stick and confirmed on review. Gritsyuk scored into an empty net with 1:05 left for a 3-1 lead. Forsberg helped keep the game scoreless by making back-to-back pad saves without his goal stick at 12:03 and 12:12 of the second period. Shortly afterward, the Devils were on a power play when Kings forward Joel Armia stuck out his stick blade and prevented the puck from sliding over the goal line after it got behind Forsberg. Laughton came out of the box on the same penalty and stayed on the ice before receiving an Adrian Kempe pass from below the goal line and scoring via a one-timer for a 1-0 lead at 15:57 of the second. Mantha tied it 1-1 at 18:43 of the second. Jesper Boqvist circled behind the Los Angeles net before passing the puck out to Mantha at the top of the left circle. He stopped the puck with his skate, skated into the circle and avoided two defenders before snapping a shot past Forsberg. The Kings were outshot 14-3 in the second period after both teams combined for just nine shots in the first period. --Field Level Media

item.title: Texans WR Tank Dell activated to return after 22-month recovery
item.description: The Texans formally activated Tank Dell to the active roster on Saturday and the receiver is set to play for the first time in 22 months when Houston hosts the New York Giants on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Texans formally activated Tank Dell to the active roster on Saturday and the receiver is set to play for the first time in 22 months when Houston hosts the New York Giants on Sunday. Dell sustained a serious left knee injury in Week 16 of the 2024 season against the Kansas City Chiefs and missed all of last season. Dell was injured while making a 30-yard touchdown catch in the third quarter against the Chiefs on Dec. 21, 2024. He dislocated his kneecap, tore three ligaments (ACL, MCL, LCL) and tore the meniscus. Dell said earlier this week that he's aware people are wondering how his knee will hold up. "I know it's a lot of questions, like, 'How he gonna look when he gets tackled?'" Dell said. "I don't care about none of that. I'm ready to get tackled. I'm gonna be joyful. Y'all gonna see the passion I have after I had that first catch." Dell, who turns 27 on Oct. 29, started this season on injured reserve. The Texans opened his 21-day practice window on Oct. 6, and Dell began practicing the following day. Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said earlier this week that Dell's explosiveness remains impressive. "He's still quick as ever," Ryans said. "Ask our defenders who was covering him the past couple weeks, he's been putting us in some tough matchups and practice the past two weeks. I expect him to go out on Sunday and do the same thing. Really stress defenders and that's what Tank is going to do with his speed, his playmaking ability." Dell made 98 catches for 1,376 yards and 10 touchdowns in 25 games (18 starts) over his first two NFL seasons. He was a third-round pick in 2023 out of Houston. The Texans also elevated cornerback Bryce Hall and linebacker Kenneth Murray from the practice squad for Sunday's game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Vídeo omite trecho de live em que Bolsonaro defende remédios sem eficácia contra Covid-19
item.description: Um vídeo em que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro imita uma pessoa com falta de ar e defende o "tratamento inicial" para a Covid-19 omite os trechos em que o político citou o uso de remédios sem eficácia comprovada contra a doença como parte do tal "tratamento".
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo em que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro imita uma pessoa com falta de ar e defende o "tratamento inicial" para a Covid-19 omite os trechos em que o político citou o uso de remédios sem eficácia comprovada contra a doença como parte do tal "tratamento". O vídeo está nas redes ao menos desde novembro de 2025 , e voltou a circular depois do debate entre os candidatos a presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) nesta sexta-feira, na Globo , quando Lula mencionou o episódio. "Mais uma fake news que está caindo por terra. Como vocês viram, o presidente Bolsonaro jamais debochou das pessoas que estavam com falta de ar. A verdade é que ele estava denunciando o 'protocolo Mandetta', que recomendava as pessoas a procurarem os hospitais somente quando já estavam com falta de ar... Inclusive, o presidente sempre defendeu o tratamento precoce", diz uma mulher no vídeo , que circula no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. Flávio também postou o vídeo em seu Instagram como resposta à afirmação de Lula durante o debate de que Bolsonaro "apareceu na televisão rindo e imitando uma pessoa morrendo asfixiada", afirmando que o petista "mentiu" quando citou o episódio. As imagens do ex-presidente são de uma live transmitida em 18 de março de 2021. O vídeo checado critica a forma como a "mídia" teria retratado a imitação de Bolsonaro. Nos posts, Bolsonaro defende que pessoas com sintomas de Covid-19 procurem um médico imediatamente e afirma que "milhares de pessoas" se beneficiaram "desse tratamento inicial". Em seguida, as publicações mostram o trecho em que o ex-presidente ironiza a recomendação atribuída por ele ao ex-ministro da Saúde Luiz Henrique Mandetta e imita uma pessoa sem ar. No entanto, o corte não mostra o que Bolsonaro fala entre a recomendação de atendimento médico imediato e a menção aos supostos beneficiados pelo "tratamento inicial". "Alguns nem vão, já tomam logo o remédio pra matar piolho. Se falar o nome, também não pode. Eu tomei um outro, e me dei bem", disse . O "remédio para matar piolho" é a ivermectina, um vermífugo, e o que Bolsonaro disse ter tomado é a hidroxicloroquina . Ambos nunca tiveram eficácia comprovada contra a Covid-19 e não figuram entre os tratamentos recomendados pela Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS). É neste contexto que Bolsonaro afirma que "milhares de pessoas" se beneficiaram "desse tratamento inicial". Mais adiante, em outro trecho também omitido, o ex-presidente diz que quem fosse contra o tratamento sugerido por ele poderia seguir "a receita do ministro Mandetta". Em 2021, na CPI da Covid, o ex-ministro da Saúde negou que tivesse dado a orientação de aguardar o agravamento de sintomas para buscar atendimento médico. Procurada pela reportagem, a campanha de Flávio não respondeu a um pedido de comentário sobre a publicação do vídeo editado. VEREDICTO Enganoso. O vídeo omite que o "tratamento inicial" recomendado por Jair Bolsonaro era composto por medicamentos sem eficácia comprovada contra a Covid-19. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 .
